packages_not_loaded.title: Plex Dashboard: packages not enabled
packages_not_loaded.description:
The Plex Dashboard package was written to `/config/packages/plex_dashboard.yaml`, but it doesn't appear to be loaded.

Add this to your `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
```
